place: 北京長安街・天安門廣場周邊

title.zh: 五月中旬北京工人、印刷與機械單位及廣大市民上街遊行聲援
title.en: Mid-May: Beijing factory workers, machinery and print work-units, and citizens join mass rallies

summary.zh: 5 月 17 日至 18 日，面對廣場絕食學生的僵局，北京聲援規模擴大至全城各行各業。大批國營工廠職工（包括機械、印刷、紡織等企業與廠礦車隊）、機關工作人員及普通市民打著單位橫幅湧上長安街與天安門廣場周邊遊行聲援，市內遊行與圍觀人潮估計達上百萬人。
summary.en: On 17–18 May, as the student hunger strike continued, solidarity demonstrations expanded across Beijing's workplaces and neighborhoods. Workers from state factories—including machinery, printing, and textile enterprises—alongside office staff and ordinary residents marched along Chang'an Avenue and around Tiananmen Square under work-unit banners in crowds estimated at over a million.
